scope: Read-only bounded source/dataflow review of three core Python sink records and three C path records. No alerts dismissed, no scan policy changed, no source files edited by this review.

counts.interpretation: Raw SARIF results cover full analyzed source. The PR gate reports its new-alert/baseline comparison subset. These are different populations; 1413 and 519 must not be presented as two counts of the same event.

reviewed_findings.assessment: Explicit operator-requested Python execution interface. The -c/stdin modes intentionally accept code. Observed source is process argv, not parsed release evidence or a network request. Launcher startup isolation is a separate property.
controls: artifact/python-env.sh invokes CPython with -I -S -B and a fresh private pycache_prefix
artifact/python_bootstrap.py clears PYTHON* environment names and places repository import roots after standard-library paths
script-path mode checks a non-symlink regular file resolved inside the repository
reviewed_findings.boundary: Any caller that promotes untrusted data into a -c code argument would need its own validation. This review does not establish that property for every caller.
reviewed_findings.disposition: Documented interface boundary; no scanner dismissal.

reviewed_findings.assessment: The reported taint reaches repository selector values for a fixed /usr/bin/git invocation. The shown paths do not choose a program or add command tokens.
controls: Path resolves to an existing repository with a non-symlink .git directory
--git-dir=<root> and --work-tree=<root> each remain one argument; the executable is fixed
Minimal environment removes caller GIT_* selectors, PATH overrides and system/global Git configuration; fsmonitor/hooks/attributes/excludes are explicitly controlled
Publication verifier path additionally requires a direct child of its fixed safe root, canonical spelling, no aliases, same UID and mode 0700
The traced operations choose fixed Git subcommands; commit identities are checked by COMMIT_RE in the provenance helpers
reviewed_findings.boundary: The generic helper accepts caller-supplied args. Its safety depends on the invoking helper constructing the intended Git operation; this record covers the two SARIF-origin command paths and does not certify every possible caller.
reviewed_findings.disposition: Source-specific argument and environment controls confirmed; no scanner dismissal.

reviewed_findings.assessment: This module enforces process ownership, deadlines and bounded output. It intentionally executes the supplied argv and is not an executable allowlist or a general argument-injection sanitizer.
controls: No generic command-execution CLI is exposed by this module
argv is copied and checked for non-empty strings/NUL; Popen receives argv plus an explicit executable without shell parsing
Explicit process environments are validated and passed exactly; omitted environment still inherits by design
Related source 1: android_runtime_control.py takes the hosted runner ANDROID_HOME/avdmanager, builds adb/emulator paths and uses fixed diagnostic command operands
Related source 2: android_sdk_package.py clears Java injection environment variables, requires a canonical absolute JAVA_HOME and then invokes its bin/java --version
Related source 3: android_sdk_package.py accepts an operator-selected --gradle program and verifies version; it remains an explicit toolchain selection interface

Related source 4: apple_sdk_profile.py admits host_target from HOST_TARGETS before placing it in cargo --target; source manifest/package/feature arguments are fixed and application arguments follow --
reviewed_findings.boundary: Only the four representative SARIF source paths were traced. The other 19 related source entries remain open in this bounded review; shell=False alone is not a disposition for them.
reviewed_findings.disposition: Partial caller review complete; aggregate command-injection finding remains open.

reviewed_findings.assessment: The sink appends fixed phase receipts in the qualification client. In the actual harness, QPC_TEST_* values are discarded before the harness supplies its own generated receipt path.
controls: setup_io_phase admits action io and phase 1..4
O_APPEND|O_CLOEXEC|O_NOFOLLOW; fstat requires a regular same-UID mode-0600 single-link file before writes
continuity_c_faults.Matrix removes inherited LD_*, DYLD_*, QPERIAPT_* and QPC_TEST_* at lines 249-250
Matrix.receipt generates fixed-prefix .events leaves under its evidence output; inject supplies target/log explicitly
continuity_setup_io.Matrix builds its private case root and invokes setup-io-activate with the intended installation.redb and generated receipt
reviewed_findings.boundary: The C function alone does not confine every same-user path. The documented protection includes the harness-owned environment and private workspace. O_NOFOLLOW checks the final component, not all ancestor directories.
reviewed_findings.disposition: Harness-specific confinement and descriptor constraints established; no scanner dismissal.

reviewed_findings.assessment: This independent fault-injection probe selects the exact inode whose sync calls will be observed. It is compiled as a separate probe by continuity_c_consumer.py and is not linked into the SDK library.
controls: Target path must be absolute
O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC|O_NOFOLLOW followed by same-UID/0600/regular/single-link fstat checks
The admitted device+inode pair is retained and compared against each intercepted fd
Harness rebuilds QPC_TEST_* values and chooses target files under its private temporary case root
reviewed_findings.boundary: Direct execution with operator-controlled environment is an explicit fault-injection interface; no claim of accepting hostile caller-selected paths is made.
reviewed_findings.disposition: Harness-specific target selection and inode checks established; no scanner dismissal.

reviewed_findings.assessment: The independently built probe creates a fresh phase receipt in the harness-selected evidence directory.
controls: Absolute log path required
O_WRONLY|O_APPEND|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_CLOEXEC|O_NOFOLLOW with creation mode 0600 prevents overwriting an existing target
Matrix filters inherited injected environment and supplies the fresh receipt name
continuity_package.py:429-437 admits a fresh evidence output and creates a private mkdtemp workspace; fault cases add mode-0700 subdirectories
reviewed_findings.boundary: The file-open flags do not themselves impose a directory allowlist; harness path construction and ownership supply that boundary.
reviewed_findings.disposition: Harness-specific fresh receipt creation established; no scanner dismissal.
